items.event_time_ist: Oct 9-11, 2026 (first reported Oct 9; surfaced in this watch's sweeps now)
items.source_name: Contra Linea / Latinus (via Wikipedia), corroborated by AP/CNN
items.summary: First concrete Guerrero damage figures in this watch from Simon's weekend pass: ~65,780 customers lost electricity across Guerrero (Contra Linea, Oct 9); in Acapulco, 150 power poles downed, 20 houses flooded, 2 people injured (Latinus, Oct 9), and the Puerto Marques electrical substation was flooded and shut down. AP/CNN corroborate that federal authorities were working to restore power in Acapulco. Chilpancingo toll unchanged at 1 (Albino Moreno Jimenez, 71, wall collapse).
items.title: Simon weekend damage figures surface for Guerrero/Acapulco: ~65,780 customers out, 150 poles downed, 2 injured

items.event_time_ist: Oct 12, 2026 (AP update, surfaced in this watch's sweeps now)
items.summary: New details on Rachel's Baja toll (Ensenada): the four recovered bodies are a 13-year-old girl (Sunday) plus two women and a 4-year-old boy (Monday); six remain missing - four in Ensenada and a father-son fishing pair from San Felipe who did not return Saturday. The 32 people rescued by military helicopter at the Ensenada ranch included 22 foreigners - Germans and Americans, some missionaries; 13 of the 32 were youths. ~14,000 federal and state personnel deployed across Baja California. AFP confirms the four recovered bodies and the helicopter rescues.
items.title: Baja toll refined: four bodies identified in Ensenada, 22 foreigners among 32 helicopter rescues, 14,000 personnel deployed
